[[Academie de Foot Amadou Diallo|Djékanou]] 3-3 [[AS Denguélé|Denguélé]] | winners = | promoted = | relegated = | prevseason = 2011 | nextseason = 2013–14 }} The '''2012-13 [[Ligue 1 (Côte d'Ivoire)|Ligue 1]]''' season was the 55th edition and current of the top-tier competition of Côte d'Ivoire football. The season will start on 2 November 2012 and be in play until 31 July 2013. [https://web.archive.org/web/20130404082742/http://www.mtnfootball.com/africa/cote-d-ivoire/ligue-1-mtn] The Ivoirian Ligue 1 is back to its 2010 formula, consisting of a single group of fourteen teams, after it followed a revised format for two seasons following [[Politics of Ivory Coast|political problems in the country]].
